name: Detail Regions
description: Redraws every box of a picture at the model's full detail, one after the other: each box (from Find by Text, for faces or eyes) is padded, cut out, scaled to Target size, redrawn by the model from a part of its own picture (Denoise), scaled back and pasted in through a soft edge. Each box sees the picture as the one before left it. No boxes: the picture passes through and the model is not called.

inputs.name: conditioning
inputs.label: Conditioning
inputs.description: What each box is redrawn to look like: Text Encode's, for a prompt that describes what is in the boxes.

inputs.name: boxes
inputs.label: Boxes
inputs.description: One box a line, x1 y1 x2 y2 in the picture's pixels: Find by Text's Boxes. Empty: nothing is redrawn.

inputs.name: padding
inputs.label: Padding
inputs.description: Pixels of the picture kept around each box on each side, so the model sees what surrounds it. A box that is under 16 pixels on a side after padding is left as it is.

inputs.name: target_size
inputs.label: Target size
inputs.description: The long side each crop is redrawn at, in pixels; the short side keeps its shape (both in steps of 16).

inputs.name: denoise
inputs.label: Denoise
inputs.description: How far each crop moves from itself, 1 ignores it. Read as ComfyUI reads it: the schedule is made int(Steps / Denoise) long and its last Steps steps run.

inputs.name: denoise_scale
inputs.label: Denoise scale
inputs.description: fixed: Denoise for every box. smaller_less: a small box gets less (down to 0.4 of it), smaller_more: a small box gets more (down to 0.4 of it), by the box's share of the picture.

inputs.name: guidance
inputs.label: Guidance
inputs.description: How closely to follow the prompt (CFG). 1 for distilled models such as FLUX.2 Klein.

inputs.name: feather
inputs.label: Feather
inputs.description: How far the redrawn crop fades in from each of its four edges, in pixels of the picture (at most half the crop).

inputs.name: seed
inputs.label: Seed
inputs.description: Each box uses Seed + Seed shift x 100000 + the box's place in the list (a skipped box counts).

inputs.name: seed_shift
inputs.label: Seed shift
inputs.description: Moves every box's seed, so two Detail Regions in a row (faces, then eyes) do not draw from the same noise.
